name: io.github.daniel-munoz/claude-checkpoint-mcp
description: MCP server that checkpoints Claude Code session context to survive crashes and token limits

environmentVariables.name: CHECKPOINT_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path of the default project to checkpoint, used when the client has no current project (e.g. Claude Desktop). A projectRoot argument on a tool call takes precedence.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set automatically by Claude Code; do not set it yourself. Selects the per-session checkpoint file (.claude-checkpoints/<session-id>.json). Without it the server uses the shared .claude-checkpoint file.
